ED_Title: Election of the President of the General Assembly at its eighty-first session
ED_DecisionText: At its 85th plenary meeting, on 2 June 2026, the General Assembly, in accordance with Article 21 of the Charter of the United Nations, rule 30 of the rules of procedure of the Assembly and paragraph 1 of the annex to resolution 33/138 of 19 December 1978, elected Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh as President of the General Assembly at its eighty-first session.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
